implementation.bounded_linear: single boxed array of32 borrowed Name slices, seeded after third successful item with non-whitespace tail
implementation.complexity: fixed32-name linear prefix then O(n log n) ordered comparisons; no hashing
implementation.empty_shortcut: exact raw tail length zero becomes Done at construction; whitespace remains parsed
implementation.ordered_handoff: unique33rd item checks the32 stored names, then seeds ordered map only if another raw tail remains
implementation.phase: OwnCheck enum stored directly in Phase, no redundant outer Box
implementation.positions: recovered from borrowed key offsets for linear duplicates and ordered-map seeding
implementation.short_prefix: 0801 first/second/third raw-key preflight without value replay

required_gates: fresh public-workflow/resource/cross-format gates before any adoption
